blockingIssues.description: main.py imports agent.auth before load_dotenv(), so strict JWT_SECRET_KEY enforcement in agent/auth.py can raise at import time before .env is loaded unless the secret is pre-exported.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/environment.md to document that JWT_SECRET_KEY is required at agent/auth.py import time and must be available before auth import.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When agent-browser is unavailable per mission AGENTS.md, permit explicit fallback UI validation steps (typecheck/lint/API checks) without treating missing browser automation as procedure deviation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review observation: fullstack-worker skill mandates agent-browser UI verification, while mission AGENTS.md documents a known agent-browser outage and fallback expectations.
